description: Lip-sync audio onto one of your videos. For action="create" without engine, session_id, or face_id, the default is Sync Labs Sync 3: video_url + sound_file (base64 data URI) processes the whole clip without a face-identification step or manual timing. engine="best" explicitly selects this lane. Kling provides manual timing control with engine="kling", or with session_id/face_id when engine is omitted: (1) action="identify-face" with video_url (MP4/MOV, 2-60s, <=100MB, 720p/1080p); (2) action="create" with session_id + face_id + audio + timing IN MILLISECONDS (sound_start_time, sound_end_time, sound_insert_time) + optional speech_volume/original_audio_volume (0-100); (3) action="status" with the task_id to poll — returns a branded SwitchApp view_url when done. Charges credits on create; failed jobs are refunded.

audio_id.description: create: alternative to sound_file — an existing audio id.

engine.description: create: optional. "best" selects Sync Labs Sync 3 for whole-clip lip sync using video_url + sound_file. When engine is omitted, this lane is used unless session_id or face_id is supplied. "kling" selects the timeline flow with manual audio placement in milliseconds.

face_id.description: create: a face_id from identify-face (one face supported).

keep_background.description: create, Sync 3 lane: keep the clip's own music and room under the new speech (default true); false gives the new speech alone.

original_audio_volume.description: create: how loud the clip's own sound stays, as a percent 0-100 (default 100, the clip keeps its sound).

sound_file.description: create: base64 data URI of the audio (e.g. data:audio/mpeg;base64,...).

sound_insert_time.description: create: where in the video to place the audio, in MILLISECONDS.

speech_volume.description: create: how loud the new speech is, as a percent 0-100 (default 100).

video_url.description: identify-face: the source video (MP4/MOV, 2-60s, <=100MB, 720p/1080p). Use a SwitchApp/public URL.

name: lip_sync_video
title: Lip Sync Video
